question: Simplify 63 - [15 + {17 - (9 - 7 + 1)}].
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify 63 - [15 + {17 - (9 - 7 + 1)}]

**Formula used:**

Use the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

63 - [15 + {17 - (9 - 7 + 1)}]

⇒ 63 - [15 + {17 - (3)}]

⇒ 63 - [15 + 14]

⇒ 63 - 29

⇒ 34

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
